title: Asset Index
description: Images extracted from the source documents, each carrying the anchoring context that makes it placeable — which section it illustrates, not just its bytes. Stage 0 output (extract_assets.py). Stage 3 chooses which to place; Stage 5 audits that every screenshot-role asset was placed or explicitly left unused with a reason.

file.description: Path under the run's assets/ directory

doc_order_index.description: Position among all assets in document reading order

section_id.description: Matches a source_map.json section_id where determinable

caption_candidate.description: Text pulled from the paragraph immediately following the image, where FSD captions typically live

alt_text.description: docPr name/descr, when the source document set it

repeat_count.description: How many times this exact image content appears across the document set

role.description: A guess from size, repeat_count, and context. Only 'screenshot' assets are subject to the Stage 5 placement audit.

quality.description: A 'low_res' asset needs an explicit acknowledgement flag on its placing block before Stage 4 will place it.
